reasons.claim: The written chain reaches Ibn Abbas through Ubaydullah.
Ubayy b. Ka'b speaks inside the narrated encounter and relays the Prophet's words, so under rulings 2 and 9 he is the last link.
Both readers stop at Ibn Abbas and omit the one whose words the report relays.

notes: Ubayy answers within the encounter and quotes the Prophet: last link (rulings 2, 9)

reviews.uncertainty_note: One could read Ibn Abbas as the reporter of a story in which Ubayy speaks, but ruling 9 makes the speaker the last link.

reasons.claim: Three co-transmitters join at al-Mu'tamir.
The chain then runs through his father and Abu Uthman to Abd al-Rahman.
The interjection is a gloss, not a link.
Three shaykhs join at Isma'il.
The chain ends at Abu Hurayra, who quotes the Prophet.

reviews.question: al-Faqih's statement of the compiler's routes («طرق») to a source, with no saying

reasons.claim: The text states the compiler's route to Yusuf b. Ya'qub with no saying, which is an unruled question.
If it is stored as a route, the readers' links are right: the description after the name is not a link.
reasons.quote: عن يوسف بن يعقوب أخي يونس بن يعقوب

reasons.claim: Three «ح» branches meet at Shu'ba.
The shared tail ends at «أبيه» before the Prophet.
reasons.quote: عن المنذر بن جرير، عن أبيه، عن النبي

reasons.claim: Ya'la wrote to Ayyub, so Ya'la is a link.
reasons.quote: قال كتب إلى يعلى بن حكيم

reasons.claim: The closing reference to another version is a variant remark, not a route (ruling 6).
reasons.quote: ثم ذكر بمثل حديث ابن علية

reasons.claim: Isma'il asks the Imam, who answers; the asker and then the one asked are the links (ruling 3).
The chain ends at Anas, and the unnamed asker in the story is not a link.
The narrator speaks to the Imam, who answers, so the Imam is the last link.
The Imam's father appears only inside his answer, so he is not a link.
The chain runs through «آبائه», and the speaker named after the chain is the last link (ruling 2).
reasons.quote: عن آبائه عليهم السلام قال: قال أمير المؤمنين

reasons.claim: «عمه» together with a name is one link.
reasons.quote: عن عمه محمد بن أبي القاسم
